engineered_features.description: Total number of family members aboard (SibSp + Parch + 1)

engineered_features.name: Title
engineered_features.description: Extracted title from passenger name (Mr, Mrs, Miss, Master, Rare)

engineered_features.name: IsAlone
engineered_features.description: Binary indicator for passengers traveling alone (FamilySize == 1)

modeling_strategy: Given the dataset size (891 samples) and binary target (Survived), a regularized logistic regression or gradient boosting classifier (e.g., XGBoost / LightGBM) is recommended. Key features to include are Sex, Title, Pclass, FamilySize, Age (imputed), Fare (log-transformed due to skewness), and IsAlone. Perform 5-fold stratified cross-validation. Use class weighting or SMOTE to handle class imbalance (survival rate ~38%). Evaluate with ROC-AUC and accuracy. Feature importance from tree-based models can provide further insights. The statistical tests indicate Sex, Pclass, Title, and Fare are significant predictors; Age and FamilySize may also contribute.
